name: Italian Sausage
siboNotes: Plain Italian sausage is generally well-tolerated, but check labels for added garlic or onion powder which can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully - avoid varieties with garlic or onion powder
Cook thoroughly to 160°F internal temperature for food safety
Remove casings if texture is problematic for digestion
Pair with low-FODMAP vegetables and herbs for flavor enhancement
alternatives: Plain ground pork seasoned with fennel and oregano
Homemade sausage with safe herbs and spices
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially B12
Good source of zinc and selenium
